query:
select
  p.status,
  coalesce(p.cardcom_account_id,'(null)') as cardcom_account,
  case when p.cardcom_transaction_id is null then 'no-txn'
       when p.cardcom_transaction_id ~ '^(mock|test|e2e)' then 'mock-txn' else 'txn' end as txn_kind,
  case when u.email ~* '(e2e|test|example\.com|playwright|mock)' then 'test-user' else 'user' end as buyer_kind,
  count(*)::int as n,
  sum(coalesce(p.amount_ils_agorot, (p.amount_ils*100)::bigint))::bigint as agorot,
  min(p.created_at)::date as first_at, max(p.created_at)::date as last_at
from payments p join orders o on o.id=p.order_id left join auth.users u on u.id=o.user_id
where p.kind='charge' or p.kind is not null
group by 1,2,3,4 order by 5 desc
